Following her miraculous revival and return as a 20-year-old, she comes to know that her son does not, in fact, hate her like she'd assumed he did. However, in exchange for her second chance at life she's forced into playing deadly mind games with others in the same situation as herself.

After a miscalculation, Princess Stephanie, who holds supreme power in the empire, dies mysteriously on the eve of her coronation as Queen.

From their conversations, she learns that her enemies have thrived after her death and become powerful bosses. What should she do now?

description.en:
Hey, you're not allowed to treat people as food without permission!
[Sinister Dark Entity Gong x Young inexperienced daoist priest with terrible exorcist skills] Yin Sanyi, a live streamer Daoist Priest gets involved in a sacrificial ceremony to the incarnation of a dark entity— Nai Ruohe, who only views him as a yummy snack.

Not willing to accept being considered a mere loaf of bread, Sanyi starts to wonder how he could reverse the tides and tame that gluttonous malevolent entity.

Ten thousand years ago, a great and powerful Digimon was defeated and sealed away by the Holy Knights as the "Digi Core". Years later, a virus infected the digital world, leaving only those that possessed the D-Antibody (X-Antibody) remaining. The only members of the Holy Knights remaining are Omega of Power (Omnimon X), Duke of Courage (MedievalGallantmon/Gallantmon X), and Magna of Miracles (Magnamon).  
  
At the start of the series, the "God of Death" MetalPhantomon draws Hikaru, Kiyoshi, Masuken, and Teru into the digital world. Originally, Hikaru is left alone with his Digimon (which starts out as a Dorimon), and has to battle his friends Teru and Masuken, who are under MetalPhantomon's control.  
  
At one point, MetalPhantomon steals the "Dragon Spirit" of Masaru's partner, who is now a Dorumon. While MetalPhantomon uses it to revive the Digi-Core, Hikaru, Teru, and Masuken learn from Omega of Power that they can get a new Dragon Spirit from Duke of Courage - with this, they can save Dorumon's life. But when they arrive in Duke's area of the Digital World, they are given a series of tests by Duke's servant, MameTyramon.  
  
After completing the tests and battling Duke himself, they manage to earn Dorumon a new Dragon Spirit. However, now they must battle MetalPhantomon, who has resurrected the Digi-Core as Dexmon. In the end, Hikaru and the others manage to save their friend Kiyoshi, who was sealed inside Dexmon, and return to the real world.
description.pt-br: Dez mil anos atrás, um grande e poderoso Digimon foi derrotado e selado pelos Cavaleiro Reais. Anos mais tarde, um vírus infectou o mundo digital, deixando apenas aqueles que possuíam o X-Anticorpo restante. Os únicos membros dos Cavaleiros Reias restantes são Omegamon X, Dukemon X e Magnamon. No início da série, o "Deus da Morte" MetalPhantomon desenha Hikaru, Kiyoshi, Masuken, e Teru para o mundo digital. Originalmente, Hikaru é deixado sozinho com seu Digimon (que começa como uma Dorimon), e tem que lutar contra seus amigos, Teru e Masuken, que estão sob o controle de MetalPhantomon.

description.en:
**“This year’s top scholar is going to be me!”** declared Long Yao, the bandit chief’s daughter. 
**“An idiot like you?”** huffed the small panther who was grinding ink nearby.

In the Age of Enlightenment, under the Yan Dynasty, there are no gender or background entry barriers to take the imperial exam.
Every scholar has the dream of becoming a top scorer on the imperial exams.
Passing the preliminary exams, and then advancing to the county-level exams is a one-in-a-million chance rigorous process.

**“If you don't successfully escort my daughter to the exam, then I won’t teach you a single word of the incantation.”**

The incantation holds the key in breaking the pantherkin’s curse.
**“Hmph!”**
The little pantherkin rolls his eyes at the girl sprawled asleep at her desk, her neck still bearing the bite mark from last night.

He wonders if he lost his mind, when he finds himself thinking: is it really the worst thing ever, if I have to take her to exams for the rest of my life?
[An energetic wild child of a girl X a tsundere little pantherkin]

description.en: In the wake of the apocalyptic Red Mist, Caleb O’Dea’s world is reduced to two truths: his family is dead, and his sister is missing. His quest for vengeance and answers leads him to the front lines of humanity’s final stand. But Caleb is a living weapon, harboring a power born of the same source as the invading horrors. To fight them, he must become like them—devouring beasts to steal their abilities, evolving into a stronger, more monstrous version of himself with every battle. This is his sacrifice. Every step toward salvation is a step into the abyss. In a world where evolution is the only law, Caleb must choose: cling to his fading humanity, or embrace the beast within to become the strongest survivor of the end times.

The only problem is— Ling Xiao is a villain, and a villain’s destiny is to be a stepping stone for the chosen one (protagonist)! The world is full of injustice and oppression against the villains! Although he was the film emperor's assistant in name, in reality he was the one being taken care of every day. These two helped similar monsters everywhere in the entertainment circle. They rebuilt the homes of displaced monsters, bringing about a pure camaraderie in which they could share their laughter and tears.

Rong Xiaoqiang is a photographer of a vlog team that specializes in shooting haunted events. The team is nameless and creates gimmicks through fraud. However, he got a DV player that could shoot ghosts, and what was captured in the viewfinder became treacherous and dangerous that ordinary people could not imagine. This camera has brought huge traffic to vlog, and the desire for money and popularity, the team members ignored the danger, followed the evil spirit's grave, and went all the way to death, every shooting became more and more dangerous.

The Six Prefectures of Zhongbo were ceded away in surrender to the external enemies, and Shen Zechuan was taken into custody in the capital, reduced to a drowning dog loathed and condemned by all. Xiao Chiye followed the scent of the furor and made his way over. But instead of setting others on him, he kicked Shen Zechuan with his very own leg that rendered the latter an invalid. Who would expect this invalid to turn around and bite him in a counterattack until he was all drenched in blood? That was the start of an epic feud between both men who tear at each other every time they come face-to-face with one another.

---
**Note:**
- After a huge backlash about the character design, the series has been undergoing a revision with a new art style, This title contains the old version.
description.pl:
Shen Zechuan jest ósmym synem zdradzieckiego księcia Jianxing, człowieka, który skazał swoje miasta i ludzi na zagładę z rąk wroga. Jako jedyny żyjący członek swojej linii, Shen Zechuan jest znienawidzony przez cały naród. A nienawiść nikogo nie płonie goręcej niż uczucie Xiao Chiye, najmłodszego syna potężnego księcia Libei.

Xiao Chiye niczego nie pragnie bardziej niż śmierci Shen Zechuana, ale ten wbrew wszelkim przeciwnościom trzyma się życia. Zamiast poddać się hańbie swojej rodziny, staje się cierniem w boku Xiao Chiye, wdzierając się do bezwzględnego świata politycznego stolicy. Jednak gdy ci dwaj zaciekli wrogowie walczą z więzami swojego losu, zostają przyciągnięci do siebie siłą, której żaden z nich się nie spodziewa — i żaden z nich nie może mieć nadziei, że się jej oprze.

Feng Wu was born with the true blood of the phoenix and was hailed as a peerless genius in all of Junwu. However, her blessing was also a curse...it placed a target on her back. After she was attacked and had her blood stolen, her master Mu Jiuzhou exhausted his spiritual power to save Feng Wu and disappeared right in front of her. Powerless, she could only watch.

Starting again from the beginning, she resolves herself "Zuo Qingyun, our relation is irreconcilable, I cannot live in a world with you in it!"

Watch how our "useless" protagonist becomes a phoenix step by step!
description.fr:
Feng Wu, une jeune fille talentueuse, perd son sang de phénix et devient inutile après avoir été piégée par son ennemi Zuo Qingyuan. Son professeur tombe dans un profond sommeil après l'avoir sauvée. Fei Chai, une étudiante en médecine traditionnelle de l'ère moderne, entre accidentellement dans ce monde fantastique par le biais d'un jeu et prend l'identité de Feng Wu. Il s'avère que Feng Wu a conclu un accord de mariage avec Jun Linyuan, prince du clan Jun Wu. Feng Wu commence une nouvelle vie, utilisant ses connaissances modernes et ses compétences médicales pour aider sa famille, tout en passant ses journées à se cultiver. Elle se fait ainsi de nouveaux amis et tombe amoureuse de Jun Linzhou.

⋆┊Adapté du novel "Godly Empress Doctor" de Su Xiaonuan

description.en:
The Occult Curio Shop is the strangest, most eccentric building in a remote ancient town that doesn’t exist on any map. It’s run by a witcher and witch sister duo, Nos and Elio. The customers who visit are all supernatural beings living in this haunted town, such as werewolves, witches, demons, vampires, ghosts, Benandanti, lizardfolk, and other magical creatures.

They take on exorcism jobs for human clients, then either reprocess the paranormal spoils they obtain or sell them directly to monsters. This kind of work makes Nos and Elio a fortune. But their obsession with traveling the world means they can never hold onto their money, and it constantly drags them into even more unexpected supernatural incidents.

The poor Duan Jiaze inherited a private zoo after graduation and was forced to bind a "rogue" app called "Lingxiao Hope Project", which ushered in bizarre "animals" such as Lu Ya, Daji, Bai Suzhen, and Black Bear Spirit.   
  
The app regularly released business-related tasks. Jiaze would be punished if he failed to complete them. In this way, Jiaze the director was forced to begin his joyful journey of worldwide fame and controlling goblins.

description.en:
**-Official**
A madhouse was blown up, and Yun Zhonghe, the director of the madhouse, traveled through time and went to another world. 29 gifted mental patients' souls went into his mind, so he got 29 weird skills! He joined the secret service of an empire and went to a hostile state. Many years passed. If he doesn't regain his true identity soon, he's going to become the Enemy Empress's husband and have children!



**-Unofficial**
One day, a mental hospital exploded leading to the transmigration of the chief of the *asylum*. He woke up in a foreign world with 29 out-of-ordinary talents he inherited from 29 out-of-ordinary patients. Follow him on the journey of seducing an enemy Regant Empress. 3 years, and another 3 years, the Empress married me and we're about to have children... I might lose my original agenda(identity)...

description.en: In the year 1620, Taichang Emperor died a mysterious and sudden death. That had caused terror and rumors to spread among the palace’s inhabitants. Every night since the Emperor’s death, strange gale howled in the city center, followed by a series of fire and murder mysteries… People believed that was the act of ‘The Wicked’…

Rowan Zhou is an infamous playboy in showbiz and everyone is convinced he doesn't care about anyone... Until a certain video of him went viral. Like a devotee, Rowan's fingers clenched around the woman's thin wrist as his eyes flared with passion. "Please, Yvonne…"

description.en: Due to all of the anger and emotions of humans, the world has been inhabited by ghosts that feed off humans. Unfortunately, these ghosts can’t be seen by ordinary humans. A high schooler has the ability to see these ghosts…

After crawling through the showbiz world for more than ten years, the film emperor Yuan Mu gained an excellent set of acting abilities, just not the right kind to save himself from being murdered.  
  
Heaven messed up then, probably, as he reincarnated in the body of a ‘young hunk’. The appearance of this ‘young hunk’ was about eighty percent similar to his former handsome self, fully satisfying his desire to look ten years younger.  
  
But the problem was——he reincarnated onto his nemesis’ bed! WTF?  
  
Now he gotta deal with the moody tycoon and his murderer. This ‘young hunk’ is tired man…  
  
But if it’s acting, no one’s gonna beat Yuan Mu. Life is a drama to act and revenge goes by the script. He’ll be in the shadows, baiting his enemies out there to fall for it. Looks like a pretty good start.  
  
Only one thing makes no sense. That tycoon-nemesis-dude.

description.en: With a system that grows stronger against it’s enemies, Ye Jun Ling who almost passed away from old age began his cheating life of cultivating with no upper limits. Divine emperor? Saint? The heavenly principles? Stand aside! Other than that, he also had several disciples. The senior disciple is a demonic sect master, with vicious heart and treacherous mind, but got easily taken care of everytime! The second disciple is a white hair loli, with the number one divine constitution, likes to cook despite being super strong, and serve her master…

altTitles.en: The Crown Prince Has Someone in His Heart

description.en:
My name is Shen Yao. The noble ladies in the capital all envy me because my childhood friends are Crown Prince and many princes and marquises. But those were all an illusion as the most annoying person is the Crown Prince. He has disliked her since childhood and even wrote a letter of engagement annulment, try his best to not marry her....... Thus, Shen Yao decided to quit, and broke off the engagement! The Crown Prince was delighted for some time for breaking off the engagement, however...... Crown Prince: "Who is the girl who played polo with Jiang Er?" Crown Prince: "Who is the girl sitting at the same table with Fifth Brother?" Crown Prince: "Who is the girl who is studying together with Kang Yi?" Servant: "Replying Your Highness, she's the lady of Minister of Military residence, Miss Shen Yao." After breaking off the engagement, the Crown Prince couldn't sleep soundly at night and could no longer forget the little green plum/little girl that used to follow him.

description.en: Shi Nidie transmigrated into the mistress of the Pleasure Palace! Originally, she planned on surviving by:  guiding the overpowered male lead Nie Guixun on his path to become a hero, help ignite passion in the lazy prodigal He Lanshan, change the tragic fate of the tsundere Dan Jiudeng, and save the loyal dog Yun Lin from certain death. To carry out her plan, she decided to take all four in as disciples, founding a new sect which defied fate and aimed to rewrite destiny. Watch Shi Nidie as she embarks on her chaotic journey of building a reverse-harem. Where she expands and strengthens the power of the Pleasure Palace!

description.en:
Drowned to death, born again. That's what it took for Huo Tianxin to realize how blind she had been to the truth. In this life, she was determined to retaliate. She refused to remain a timid, cowardly little girl. She would kill anyone who tried to hurt her loved ones! She narrowed her cold eyes dangerously.

"Shen Ruoqiu, do your worst. You're destined to fail!"

However, when the dust settled, she found herself in yet another tricky trap...

description.en: Talented player x industry elite. After five years of parting, Li Moyang's naive and shy younger brother disappeared, and he became an advertising genius known as "the first fox in the business world". In the face of his ex-boyfriend's signing contract, Li Moyang decided to launch a "comprehensive revenge" on him. It was better to let him grovel at his feet and cry for mercy! He thought he would be ashamed of himself, but he fell into the trap of the “Fox". When he found out, he was already in deep trouble and couldn't extricate himself, with his left hand to do business, and his right to love, Seeing two people falling in love, fighting bravely and passionately!
